description: Hand-verifiable fixtures for the shared forecast core. modelForward pins the shipped GLM forward pass and occlusion attributions; features pins extractFeatures against scripted ring feeds; escalation pins stepEscalation band/event/latch semantics. Every number is recomputable from the documented formulas in each section's description.

modelForward.description: GLM lr24+pairwise forward pass (324 basis terms, 325 params). Basis order: the 24 linear terms in FORECAST_FEATURE_KEYS order, then every product x_i*x_j for i<=j in lexicographic order. Fixture weights: mean[k]=k/48, scale[k]=0.5 (published dispersion only — the standardizer is folded into the coefficients, so the forward pass uses neither), coefficients[t]=(((7t+3i+5j')%11)-5)/40 where (i,j) is term t and j'=23 for a linear term, intercept=0.05, Platt a=1.25 b=-0.15. Case encodings: mixed[k]=((7k)%11)/10, at_norm_mean[k]=mean[k], zeros[k]=0. logit=intercept+sum_t coefficients[t]*t(x); rawRisk=sigmoid(a*logit+b); hidden[i]=tanh(sum over terms containing feature i of coefficients[t]*t(x)) — product terms count toward BOTH of their features, so hidden does not sum to the logit. attribution_i = rawRisk(x) - rawRisk(x with encoded[i] set to mean[i]). Regenerate with scripts/forecast/make-fixtures.ts.

features.description: Each tick i (1-based) is one wall second at ts = sessionStartTs + i*1000: apply focus snapshots in order, then desk, then decision status, then commit(ts). focus tuples are [processName, windowTitle, matchedAllow, matchedBlock]; desk tuples are [label, confidence, webcamEnabled]. expected.values are the 24 encoded features in FORECAST_FEATURE_KEYS order. Regenerate with scripts/forecast/make-fixtures.ts, which refuses to overwrite an existing pinned value — only new columns may be added.

escalation.description: stepEscalation sequences. Step i runs at ts = t0 + i*1000 with ready:true unless overridden. expected lists band, effectiveFuseSec(state, settings) and the exact events emitted by that step.
